investigation_notes.Description: Unusually high volume of file downloads from a SharePoint site by the user, totaling 290 files and exceeding the 24-hour baseline of 50. The activity uses SharePoint/Directo MSGraph with the destination appearing as a Microsoft data center, and no malicious IP reputation was observed for the source. No recent similar alerts or events were found to corroborate a confirmed exfiltration attempt, suggesting this is likely a legitimate data export, though it warrants monitoring for data sensitivity and user intent.
